##### Project general facts

Nexara by 7th Key is a residential tower shaped around thoughtful design and an urban-luxury lifestyle that balances calm and modern living. The building rises from a podium base to a rooftop level and offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside a selection of commercial units. Clean, contemporary elevations on every side give the tower a distinct presence, and each apartment includes a private balcony that extends the living space outdoors.

Residents arrive through a grand lobby reception that sets a welcoming tone for the building. The wellness offer includes a temperature-controlled adult pool, a dedicated kids' pool, a fully equipped gym and fitness area, and an outdoor yoga area for quieter moments. Social and leisure spaces cover a padel court with an adjoining lounge, a barbecue area and an outdoor rooftop cinema, while families benefit from an indoor children's play and activity area. Co-working spaces provide a professional setting within the building, and the parking levels feature EV charging facilities.

Apartments are delivered semi-furnished, with kitchens fitted with built-in appliances. Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and bathrooms follow a contemporary in    terior concept with modern finishes and a clean, understated aesthetic, designed to support comfortable and effortless everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a well-established residential community valued for its walkable character, green pockets and strong neighbourhood spirit. The district offers a balanced setting that feels both central and residential, with everyday retail, dining and leisure close at hand. Circle Mall and Five Jumeirah Village Hotel are among the established destinations within the community.

Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road provide smooth connections to the city's key districts. Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Hills Mall are within a short drive, while Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are reachable via the main road network.

Freehold ownership is available, opening the community to international buyers. The combination of central connectivity, established amenities and a calm residential atmosphere positions the area for both end users and investors seeking well-connected apartment living within the city.
